items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I want to ask you, how was Domenkis who played violin, how was he compared to Peter on and Dennis Dore...

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Oh, Ninesh played snatter, based on both of them. Ninesh, Ninesh.
He'd be right out to Peter and talk to him.
Yeah, Ninesh was pretty good. But I'd rather end for that beat. He had that.
